tracks.title: Regional responsibility
tracks.headline: Crisis procedures exercised
tracks.summary: Cyber Europe rehearsed cross-border response; outcome timings remain undisclosed.
tracks.blocker: Response-time, remedy and smaller-member representation evidence is missing.
tracks.next: Publish after-action findings and independently verify corrective actions.

tracks.title: User-owned intelligence
tracks.headline: Memory transfer available
tracks.summary: Claude documents user-mediated memory export/import with experimental limitations.
tracks.blocker: No independent preservation, exit or recovery cohort.
tracks.next: Measure successful provider switches and semantic fidelity, including failed imports.

tracks.title: Bounded agent authority
tracks.headline: Resource-bound controls specified
tracks.summary: MCP July revision supplies resource/audience rules; production effects remain unmeasured.
tracks.blocker: No complete invalid-grant attempt or revocation-tail denominator.
tracks.next: Independent resource-boundary tests paired with legitimate-use completion.

tracks.title: Cross-domain continuity
tracks.headline: Deployment integration available
tracks.summary: AWS supports third-party A2A server deployment; successful task handoffs are not established.
tracks.blocker: Deployment integration exists, but version-specific security research challenges safe handoff; no destination-permission or duplicate-effect cohort.
tracks.next: Publish a matched cross-provider handoff with destination admission and failure recovery.

tracks.title: Institutional conduits
tracks.headline: Live institutional exchange reported
tracks.summary: UOB and HSBC report completed cross-border HKD transactions; autonomous-agent involvement is unverified.
tracks.blocker: No repeat useful-exchange denominator, bounded agent authority or selective-suspension test.
tracks.next: Measure repeat institutional exchanges under purpose limits and exercised suspension.

tracks.title: Shared coordination
tracks.headline: Governance draft delivered
tracks.summary: Regional registry governance draft advances accountability and continuity provisions.
tracks.blocker: Draft is not adopted; signing concentration and registry-loss operation untested.
tracks.next: Adopt bounded rules, then exercise independent recovery and cached verification.

tracks.title: Internet & service continuity
tracks.headline: Narrow recovery reported
tracks.summary: RIPE Database web errors received a fix; this was not an Internet-wide outage.
tracks.blocker: No independent legitimate-workflow retention or recovery-tail sample.
tracks.next: Measure representative endpoints and permitted work before, during and after disruption.

tracks.title: Durable U.S. participation
tracks.headline: U.S. technology in EU operations
tracks.summary: Munich and JUPITER are two operating cases, not a market-wide participation rate.
tracks.blocker: No matched tender eligibility, recurring foreign use or support-continuity panel.
tracks.next: Observe eligible and awarded value plus retained use and a tested provider exit.

dependencies.requirement: Exported context does not convey authority; require fresh scoped grants.
Revalidate destination permissions and stop duplicate effects.
Specify recognized issuers, limits, appeal and incident contacts.
Inspect trust updates without granting universal policy power.
Preserve intent within permitted institutional operations.
Exercise selective suspension while retaining legitimate work.
Test international support and vendor replacement through disruption.
Measure reciprocal access and representation, not supplier origin alone.

demonstrations.title: Cyber Europe · coordinated crisis exercise
demonstrations.participants: ENISA; EU/EFTA national agencies; transport operators and EU entities
demonstrations.operations: Simulated rail/maritime disruption and response escalation in the same exercise, 10–11 June 2026.
demonstrations.repeat: Two-day event. Sustained production operation not established.
demonstrations.failure: Simulated cyber disruption; public after-action outcomes pending.
demonstrations.gaps: No user-agent delegation, context migration or registry-loss test established; no response-time distribution.

demonstrations.title: Third-party A2A deployment on AgentCore
demonstrations.participants: AWS Marketplace / Bedrock AgentCore and third-party A2A vendors
demonstrations.jurisdictions: Runtime deployments; independent cross-border jurisdictions undisclosed
demonstrations.operations: Procurement and configured deployment supported in one platform integration.
demonstrations.repeat: No completed-task or recurring-use denominator disclosed.
demonstrations.failure: No controlled handoff, revoked-grant rejection or recovery results disclosed.
demonstrations.gaps: Deployment availability does not establish independent authorization, task continuity or an international institutional workflow.

demonstrations.title: UOB / HSBC: live institutional value exchange
demonstrations.jurisdictions: Cross-border exchange; UOB Singapore and HSBC; execution endpoints not specified
demonstrations.operations: HKD exchange and obligation matching reported complete by August 26, 2026.
demonstrations.repeat: No recurring-volume denominator; planned SGD/USD exchanges are not counted as completed.
demonstrations.failure: No selective suspension, revoked-agent grant or failure-recovery test disclosed.
demonstrations.gaps: No AI-agent initiation or end-to-end authority/receipt/recovery chain established.

trajectories.title: Locally controlled, interoperable systems
trajectories.support: Exercised regional crisis coordination and scoped legal recognition.
trajectories.against: No common production workflow demonstrates the full mechanism chain.
trajectories.next: Repeated independent cross-domain use plus successful correction and vendor replacement.

trajectories.title: Closed regional fragmentation
trajectories.support: Restrictions and procurement boundaries can narrow eligible exchange; inspect the existing policy register.
trajectories.against: Missing data is not exclusion; continued recognition and shared interfaces are countervailing.
trajectories.next: Dated denial clauses, challenge outcomes and legitimate work lost under matched scope.

trajectories.title: Concentrated proprietary dependence
trajectories.support: Available memory migration still depends on provider extraction and import behavior.
trajectories.against: Export/import creates an exit path; no comparative switch-failure cohort is connected.
trajectories.next: Independent switch success, full cost and continuity through withdrawal of a dominant provider.

trajectories.title: Open integration with weak accountability
trajectories.support: Third-party agent deployment is available without published end-to-end authority outcomes.
trajectories.against: Resource-bound authorization rules exist; deployment counts do not establish harm.
trajectories.next: Revoked/invalid-grant rejection and reconstructable effects paired with legitimate completion.
